description: Every product iDevice covers, with its lifecycle (reported, announced, preorder, shipping, previous) and how many well-sourced reports it has (can be 0). Each entry includes its product_slug. Optional query filters by name, e.g. 'iphone 18 pro'. A line slug such as 'samsung-galaxy-ring' names the line's newest model (which can be one not yet on sale); a generation slug such as 'samsung-galaxy-ring-1' names one model; is_line: true marks a line slug, and part_of names a generation's line. Up to 20 entries per call with the total; a query narrows a longer list.

query.description: Words in the product name, e.g. 'galaxy ring'

name: list_products
title: List tracked products
